quests.title: The top step
quests.ask: Build the first row of the staircase: its single gem, in the top-left corner.
quests.nudge: The first time round the outer loop, how many gems should the inner loop put?

quests.title: Home, then the second step
quests.ask: Get back to the left side, one row down, and build the second row so it is one gem longer than the first.
quests.nudge: After a row, how far is it back to the left edge? Does that change from row to row?

quests.title: Every step one longer
quests.ask: Build the whole staircase, each row one gem longer than the row above.
quests.nudge: Which number already changes every time round the outer loop?
